description: arXiv:2605.27840v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Audio tokenizers are fundamental to unifying audio understanding and generation. Understanding requires high-level semantics, while generation demands semantic and acoustic details. Existing unified tokenizers jointly encode both in high-dimensional continuous latents, which increases the modeling burden of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs)...
